text: Reputation and governance are the two most important institutions missing from the decentralized economy, and once they are solved the remaining missing pieces are relatively easy to supply.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Eight Institutions for the Evolution of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782205

isBasedOn.name: Eight Institutions for the Evolution of Decentralization

abstract: Reputation and governance are the two most important institutions that are lack- ing in the decentralized economy. They occupy the majority of our concern for the remainder of the book. Once they are solved, the rest of the missing pieces are rela- tively easy to supply.
